description: Locale configuration file for 'Urdu' language for the Moment.js library, defining months, days, date formats, meridiem parsing, relative time expressions, and calendar settings.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Determines if the meridiem indicator corresponds to ' شام' (evening).

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the meridiem indicator ('صبح' for before noon, 'شام' for afternoon/evening) based on the hour.

methods.name: preparse
methods.description: Replaces Urdu comma '،' with English comma ',' in date strings before parsing.

methods.name: postformat
methods.description: Replaces English comma ',' with Urdu comma '،' in formatted date strings.
